question.worked_solution:
First, we clear the rational expression by multiplying both sides by $3:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5z+2}{3} & \ge 4 \\ 3\cdot (\frac{5z+2}{3}) & \ge 3\cdot 4 \\ \cancel{3}\cdot (\frac{5z+2}{\cancel{3}}) & \ge 12 \\ 5z+2 & \ge 12\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the addition and multiplication principles:

$$
\begin{aligned}5z+2 & \ge 12 \\ 5z+2-2 & \ge 12-2 \\ 5z & \ge 10 \\ \frac{5z}{5} & \ge \frac{10}{5} \\ z & \ge 2\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $z\ge 2.$
